title: All Natural, Low Cost, High Carb: Is Maple Syrup the Perfect Alternative to Gels?
content:
High-carb fueling has blown up pro racing. Now scientists want to discover whether you can join the 'carbohydrate revolution' using only maple syrup.

Read the full article at All Natural, Low Cost, High Carb: Is Maple Syrup the Perfect Alternative to Gels? on Velo.
